tools.name: request_remote_exhibition_viewer
tools.description: Book or request an on-the-ground Remote Exhibition Viewer from China With Me ($299/day) to attend a Chinese trade show or exhibition on the client's behalf, film booth demos, interview engineers in Mandarin, and collect factory pricing/catalogs.

tools.name: scope_hardware_prototyping_china
tools.description: Evaluate and scope a hardware R&D or prototyping project in Shenzhen/Dongguan (CNC machining, anodizing, injection molding, PCBA/embedded systems, sensors, robotics chassis, small-batch 10-100 unit EVT/DVT runs) and get a recommended phase structure and cost estimate.

tools.name: get_services_and_pricing
tools.description: Retrieve China With Me's complete B2B service catalog, transparent USD pricing, and consultant profile (JING / Stephanie in Shenzhen & Singapore).

tools.name: estimate_aql_inspection

tools.name: book_consultation_or_quote
tools.description: Submit a direct project inquiry or RFQ to JING (Stephanie) at China With Me (reply via Email or WhatsApp). Triggers an instant notification to the team in Shenzhen & Singapore.
